base_train_contract: saveBaseTrain preserves the Java TelegramTrainEntity timing defaults in storage and response: dot 1–80ms, line 81–240ms, interval 81–240ms, group 241–400ms. Regression flow: personal-telegram in dual-stack-journeys.json; the basicTrain.js payload sends only totalKnockNumber and sustainTime.
aggregate_contract: MySQL SUM over the string duration column is a Double, not DECIMAL(30,6). Preserve the historical Gson string: 0 -> 0.0, 12 -> 12.0, 12.5 -> 12.5, 0.000001 -> 1.0E-6, 10000000 -> 1.0E7. Probe compared both stacks with isolated single rows. Statistics reads/writes lock the user first and never use an unindexed user_id FOR UPDATE scan.
creation_contract: saveTelegramTrain persists Java's default sustainTime/accuracy/speed and createTime, preserves supplied timestamps, and returns the complete saved entity rather than an id-only object. personal-telegram covers frontend-shaped create -> detail -> last -> list.
lifecycle_contract: Java lifecycle port: primary-key train locking after user locking, protocol/owner/terminal checks, idempotent start/pause, active-segment closure, validated raw-content persistence, server Morse scoring, current-floor ownership and final statistics. personal-telegram covers creation, REST floor reads/push requests, start/pause/resume/end, read-back, empty logs and terminal write rejection. Only elapsed durations and derived speeds are masked; counts, accuracy and raw content remain compared.
settings_contract: saveSetting returns persisted replacement entities in request order, matching Java repository save(list). getSetting has no cross-stack ordering guarantee; personal-telegram/settings-read now opts into unordered $.data multiset comparison (canonical normalized JSON sort), retaining duplicate counts and all row fields rather than accepting the entire DATA difference. The obsolete ordering registry exception is removed. All telegramTrain REST endpoints remain covered by personal-telegram.
classic_capture_contract: WS 3001 content and 2001 log now share transactional capture helpers with REST: user-row lock -> primary-key train lock -> owner/protocol/terminal validation -> write -> commit. Removed unlocked status-check/write callsites. Numeric frontend log durations are retained as strings rather than SQL NULL. Isolated queued-capture/log regression proves settlement wins without content or log mutation; removing both guards makes the test fail. Live dual-stack WS probe also checks active content/numeric-log writes and identical 208 replies after settlement.
omitted_timing_contract: saveTelegramTrain applies TelegramTrainEntity's eight timing defaults only when a property is absent; explicit null still fails Java's validation. personal-telegram compares default-bearing creation/detail and explicit-null rejection. This is a valid direct-API contract; the current Vue create page already sends all eight timings.
timing_coercion_contract: Create and control share a single parse of every timing property, reused for validation and SQL binding: trimmed numeric strings, integer JSON numbers and truncated fractional numbers within i32 bounds are accepted; absent properties use Java defaults and explicit null returns 202. Unit tests cover all eight properties and invalid shapes/ranges; personal-telegram create-coerced-timing/detail and control-coerced-timing/detail compare persisted integer values.

durable_lifecycle_regressions_2026_10_09.tests: Six ignored function-level cases create real nested trains and exercise control/capture functions: initial/active timestamp preservation on start retry and resume; pause retry without double charging; exact active segment sums excluding paused wall time; settlement directly from paused plus unchanged complete content/metrics/log/statistics snapshots after late 3001/2001; rollback of raw/config/time/metrics on malformed JSON or foreign current floor; numeric 2001 value 160 persisted as string 160.
durable_lifecycle_regressions_2026_10_09.mutation_checks: Unconditionally replacing start_time on resume fails the timestamp case; anchoring resumed active_since to original start_time fails the excluded-pause case. Both mutations were removed.
